description: Ban a user from the server, optionally deleting their recent messages. Works on users who already left (pass their user ID). Safe to call directly: the first call changes nothing and returns a preview plus a confirm_token; repeating the call with the token performs the ban. Relay the preview for the user's go-ahead.

delete_message_seconds.description: Also delete their messages from the last N seconds, up to 604800 (7 days).

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

user.description: Member name, or a user ID for someone not in the server.

name: ban_member
title: Ban member
